definition: [Invading](/term/invade) the opposing team’s jungle to kill their jungle camps. Counterjungling is a common response taken when the enemy jungler shows on the map, often considered a [crossmap](/term/crossmap) [play](/term/play). Unlike clearing allied camps, counterjungling’s effects are twofold: the player gains the gold and experience from killing the camp, while the opposing jungler loses access to the same resources, creating a net relative advantage of two camps.
